atoms.sound: Bei der Umwandlung in die indirekte Rede müssen neben der Zeitverschiebung weitere Anpassungen vorgenommen werden. Diese Anpassungen betreffen die Personal- und Possessivpronomen, sowie die Ort- und Zeitangaben.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz in der indirekten Rede, indem du das jeweils passende Personalpronomen auswählst.

atoms.a: Helene said, “I run every morning before school.”
atoms.b: Helene said that ((++she I)) ran every morning before school.

atoms.a: Jim said, “I like to draw landscapes.”
atoms.b: Jim said that ((++he we)) liked to draw landscapes.

atoms.a: Sema told me, “You can sing really well.”
atoms.b: Sema told me that ((++I you)) could sing really well.

atoms.a: The teacher said, “You all must write an essay.”
atoms.b: The teacher said that ((++we you)) all had to write an essay.

atoms.a: Gwen told them, “We should practice dancing a bit more.”
atoms.b: Gwen told them that ((++they we)) should practice dancing a bit more.

instruction.text: Lies den Satz und forme ihn anschließend in die indirekte Rede um, indem du das passende Satzende auswählst.

atoms.b: Tim said, “My dog is seven years old.”

atoms.sound: Tim said that his dog was seven years old.
